analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($80.30) vs SMA5 ($86.66)/SMA20 ($91.38)/SMA50 ($91.72): confirmed short-to-mid term downtrend position, trading below all.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($91.07)/SMA200 ($83.26): suggesting potential shift to a weaker mid-to-long term trend.
· 52-week position (52.6%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (40.7 → 31.7): entering oversold territory, maintaining downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.1604 → -1.0862): weakness persists, dead cross holding.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $80.37): approaching lower band, with band width at 24.11% widening.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($77.45): close to 5-day/20-day lows of 80.12.
· Swing Resistance ($92.14): significant distance from current price.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High continuation): confirmed downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.82x): surge, adding momentum to the downward move.
· Current phase diagnosis: downtrend, potential for further decline if support at 80.12 breaks. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
